mn129:30.8: so na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷiṃ kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
mn129:30.9: idampi bhikkhave paṇḍito tatiyaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn129:31.1: sa kho so bhikkhave paṇḍito kāyena sucaritaṃ caritvā vācāya sucaritaṃ caritvā manasā sucaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
mn129:32.1: yaṃ kho taṃ bhikkhave sammā vadamāno vadeyya
mn129:32.2: ekantaṃ iṭṭhaṃ ekantaṃ kantaṃ ekantaṃ manāpanti saggameva taṃ sammā vadamāno vadayya
mn129:32.3: ekantaṃ iṭṭhaṃ ekantaṃ kantaṃ ekantaṃ manāpanti.
mn129:32.4: yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave upamāpi na sukarā yāva sukhā saggāti.
mn129:32.5: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn129:33.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rājā cakkavatti sattahi ratanehi samannāgato catūhi ca iddhīhi tatonidānaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn129:34.2: idha bhikkhave rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa tadahuposathe paṇṇarase sīsanhātassa uposathikassa uparipāsādavaragatassa dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pātubhavati sahassāraṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāraparipūraṃ.
mn129:34.4: sutaṃ kho pana metaṃ yassa rañño muddhāvasittassa tadahuposathe paṇṇarase sīsanhātassa uposathikassa uparipāsādavaragatassa dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pātubhavati sahassāraṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāraparipūraṃ so hoti rājā cakkavatti
mn129:34.5: assaṃ nu kho ahaṃ rājā cakkavattīti.
mn129:35.1: atha kho bhikkhave rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto uṭṭhāyāsanā vāmena hatthena bhiṅgāraṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena cakkaratanaṃ abbhukīrati
mn129:35.2: pavattatu bhavaṃ cakkaratanaṃ abhivijinātu bhavaṃ cakkaratananti.
mn129:35.3: atha kho taṃ bhikkhave cakkaratanaṃ puratthimaṃ disaṃ pavattati anvadeva rājā cakkavatti saddhiṃ caturaṅginiyā senāya. yasmiṃ kho pana bhikkhave padese cakkaratanaṃ patiṭṭhāti tatra rājā cakkavatti vāsaṃ upeti saddhiṃ caturaṅginiyā senāya.
mn129:35.4: ye kho pana bhikkhave puratthimāya disāya paṭirājāno te rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ upasaṅkamitvā evamāhaṃsu
mn129:35.5: ehi kho mahārāja svāgataṃ mahārāja sakante mahārāja anusāsa mahārājāti.
mn129:35.7: pāṇo na hantabbo adinnaṃ nādātabbaṃ kāmesumicchā na caritabbā musā na bhāsitabbā majjaṃ na pātabbaṃ yathābhūtañca bhuñjathāti.
mn129:35.8: ye kho pana bhikkhave puratthimāya disāya paṭirājāno te rañño cakkavattissa anuyuttā ahesuṃ.
mn129:35.9: atha kho taṃ bhikkhave cakkaratanaṃ puratthimaṃ samuddaṃ ajjhogahetvā paccuttaritvā dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ pavattati …pe…
mn129:35.10: dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ samuddaṃ ajjhogahetvā paccuttaritvā pacchamaṃ disaṃ pavattati …pe…
mn129:35.11: pacchimaṃ disaṃ samuddaṃ ajjhogahetvā paccuttaritvā uttaraṃ disaṃ pavattati anvadeva rājā cakkavatti saddhiṃ caturaṅginiyā senāya. yasmiṃ kho pana bhikkhave padese cakkaratanaṃ patiṭṭhāti tatra rājā cakkavatti vāsaṃ upeti saddhiṃ caturaṅginiyā senāya.
mn129:35.12: ye kho pana bhikkhave uttarāya disāya paṭirājāno te rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ upasaṅkamitvā evamāhaṃsu
mn129:35.13: ehi kho mahārāja svāgataṃ mahārāja sakante mahārāja anusāsa mahārājāti.
mn129:35.15: pāṇo na hantabbo adinnaṃ nādātabbaṃ kāmesumicchā na caritabbā musā na bhāsitabbā majjaṃ na pātabbaṃ yathābhūtañca bhuñjathāti.
mn129:35.16: ye kho pana bhikkhave uttarāya disāya paṭirājāno te rañño cakkavattissa anuyuttā ahesuṃ.
mn129:35.17: atha kho taṃ bhikkhave cakkaratanaṃ samuddapariyantaṃ paṭhaviṃ abhivijinitvā tamenaṃ rājadhāniṃ paccāgantvā rañño cakkavattissa antepuradvāre akkhāhataṃ maññe tiṭṭhati. rañño cakkavattissa antepuradvāraṃ upasobhayamānaṃ.
mn129:35.18: rañño bhikkhave cakkavattissa evarūpaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:36.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave rañño cakkavattissa hatthiratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:36.2: sabbaseto sattappatiṭṭho iddhimā vehāsaṅgamo uposatho nāma nāgarājā.
mn129:36.4: bhaddakaṃ vata bho hatthiyānaṃ sace damathaṃ upeyyāti.
mn129:36.5: atha kho taṃ bhikkhave hatthiratanaṃ seyyathāpi nāma bhaddo hatthājānīyo dīgharattaṃ suparidanto evameva damathaṃ upeti.
mn129:36.6: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave rājā cakkavatti tameva hatthiratanaṃ vīmaṃsamāno pubbaṇhasamayaṃ abhirūhitvā samuddapariyantaṃ paṭhaviṃ anupariyāyitvā tameva rājadhāniṃ paccāgantvā pātarāsamakāsi.
mn129:36.7: rañño bhikkhave cakkavattissa evarūpaṃ hatthiratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:37.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave rañño cakkavattissa assaratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:37.2: sabbaseto kākasīso muñjakeso iddhimā vehāsaṅgamo valāhako nāma assarājā.
mn129:37.3: taṃ disvāna rañño cakkavattissa cittaṃ pasīdati
mn129:37.4: bhaddakaṃ vata bho assayānaṃ sace damathaṃ upeyyāti.
mn129:37.5: atha kho taṃ bhikkhave assaratanaṃ seyyathāpi nāma bhaddo assājānīyo dīgharattaṃ suparidanto evameva damathaṃ upeti.
mn129:37.6: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave rājā cakkavatti tameva assaratanaṃ vīmaṃsamāno pubbaṇhasamayaṃ abhirūhitvā samuddapariyantaṃ paṭhaviṃ anupariyāyitvā tameva rājadhāniṃ paccāgantvā pātarāsamakāsi.
mn129:37.7: rañño bhikkhave cakkavattissa evarūpaṃ assaratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:38.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave rañño cakkavattissa maṇiratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:38.2: so hoti maṇi veḷuriyo subho jotimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato.
mn129:38.3: tassa kho pana bhikkhave maṇiratanassa ābhā samantā yojanaṃ phuṭā hoti.
mn129:38.4: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave rājā cakkavatti tameva maṇiratanaṃ vīmaṃsamāno caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ sannayhitvā maṇiṃ dhajaggaṃ āropetvā rattandhakāratimisāya pāyāsi.
mn129:38.5: ye kho pana bhikkhave samantā gāmā ahesuṃ. te tenobhāsena kammante payojesuṃ divāti maññamānā.
mn129:38.6: rañño bhikkhave cakkavattissa evarūpaṃ maṇiratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:39.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave rañño cakkavattissa itthīratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:39.2: sā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā nātidīghā nātirassā nātikisā nātithūlā nātikāḷikā nāccodātā atikkantā mānusaṃ vaṇṇaṃ appattā dibbaṃ vaṇṇaṃ.
mn129:39.3: tassa kho pana bhikkhave itthīratanassa evarūpo kāyasamphasso hoti seyyathāpi nāma tulapicuno vā kappāsapicuno vā.
mn129:39.4: tassa kho pana bhikkhave itthīratanassa sīte uṇhāni gattāni honti uṇhe sītāni gattāni honti.
mn129:39.5: tassa kho pana bhikkhave itthīratanassa kāyato candanagandho vāyati mukhato uppalagandho vāyati.
mn129:39.6: taṃ kho pana bhikkhave itthīratanaṃ cakkavattissa pubbuṭṭhāyinī hoti pacchānipātinī kiṃkārapaṭissāvinī manāpacārinī piyavādinī.
mn129:39.7: taṃ kho pana bhikkhave itthīratanaṃ rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ manasāpi no aticarati kuto pana kāyena.
mn129:39.8: rañño bhikkhave cakkavattissa evarūpaṃ itthīratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:40.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave rañño cakkavattissa gahapatiratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:40.2: tassa kammavipākajaṃ dibbaṃ cakkhu pātubhavati yena nidhiṃ passati sasāmikampi assāmikampi.
mn129:40.4: appossukko tvaṃ deva hohi ahante dhanena dhanakaraṇīyaṃ karissāmīti.
mn129:40.5: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave cakkavatti tameva gahapatiratanaṃ vīmaṃsamāno nāvaṃ abhirūhitvā majjhe gaṅgāya nadiyā sotaṃ ogāhitvā gahapatiratanaṃ etadavoca
mn129:40.7: tenahi mahārāja ekaṃ tīraṃ nāvā upetūti.
mn129:40.9: atha kho taṃ bhikkhave gahapatiratanaṃ ubhohi hatthehi udake omasitvā pūraṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇassa kumbhiṃ uddharitvā rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ etadavoca
mn129:40.10: alamettāvatā mahārāja katamettāvatā mahārāja pūjitamettāvatā mahārājāti.
mn129:40.12: alamettāvatā gahapati katamettāvatā gahapati pūjitamettāvatā gahapatīti.
mn129:40.13: rañño bhikkhave cakkavattissa evarūpaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:41.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave rañño cakkavattissa parināyakaratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:41.2: paṇḍito byatto medhāvī paṭibalo rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ upaṭṭhapetabbaṃ upaṭṭhāpetuṃ apayāpetabbaṃ apayāpetuṃ ṭhapetabbaṃ ṭhapetuṃ.
mn129:41.5: rañño bhikkhave cakkavattissa evarūpaṃ parināyakaratanaṃ pātubhavati.
mn129:41.6: rājā bhikkhave cakkavatti imehi ratanehi samannāgato hoti.
mn129:42.2: idha bhikkhave rājā cakkavatti abhirūpo hoti dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato ativiya aññehi manussehi.
mn129:42.3: rājā bhikkhave cakkavatti imāya paṭhamāya iddhiyā samannāgato hoti.
mn129:43.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave rājā cakkavatti dīghāyuko hoti ciraṭṭhitiko ativiya aññehi manussehi.
mn129:43.2: rājā bhikkhave cakkavatti imāya dutiyāya iddhiyā samannāgato hoti.
mn129:44.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave rājā cakkavatti appābādho hoti appātaṅko samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato nātisītāya nāccuṇhāya ativiya aññehi manussehi.
mn129:44.2: rājā bhikkhave cakkavatti imāya tatiyāya iddhiyā samannāgato hoti.
mn129:45.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave rājā cakkavatti brāhmaṇagahapatikānaṃ piyo hoti manāpo.
mn129:45.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave pitā puttānaṃ piyo hoti manāpo
mn129:45.3: evameva kho bhikkhave rājā cakkavatti brāhmaṇagahapatikānaṃ piyo hoti manāpo.
mn129:45.4: rañño bhikkhave cakkavattissa brāhmaṇagahapatikā piyā honti manāpā.
mn129:45.5: seyyathāpi bhikkhave pitu puttā piyā honti manāpā
mn129:45.6: evameva kho bhikkhave rañño cakkavattissa brāhmaṇagahapatikā piyā honti manāpā.
mn129:45.7: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave rājā cakkavatti caturaṅginiyā senāya uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyāsi.
mn129:45.8: atha kho bhikkhave brāhmaṇagahapatikā rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ upasaṅkamitvā evamāhaṃsu
mn129:45.9: ataramāno deva yāhi yathā taṃ mayaṃ cirataraṃ passeyyāmāti.
mn129:45.11: ataramāno sārathi pesehi yathāhaṃ brāhmaṇagahapatike cirataraṃ passeyyanti.
mn129:45.12: rājā bhikkhave cakkavatti imāya catutthāya iddhiyā samannāgato hoti.
mn129:45.13: rājā bhikkhave cakkavatti imāhi catūhi iddhīhi samannāgato hoti.
mn129:46.2: api nu kho rājā cakkavatti imehi sattahi ratanehi samannāgato imāhi catūhi ca iddhīhi tatonidānaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyethāti.
mn129:46.3: ekamekenapi bhante ratanena samannāgato rājā cakkavatti tatonidānaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha ko pana vādo sattahi ratanehi catūhi ca iddhīhīti.
mn129:47.1: atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ pāṇimattaṃ pāsāṇaṃ gahetvā bhikkhū āmantesi
mn129:47.3: katamo nu kho mahantataro yo cāyaṃ mayā paritto pāṇimatto pāsāṇo gahito himavā pabbatarājāti.
mn129:47.4: appamattako ayaṃ bhante bhagavatā paritto pāṇimatto pāsāṇo gahito himavantaṃ pabbatarājānaṃ upanidhāya saṅkhampi na upeti kalabhāgampi na upeti upanidhampi na upetīti.
mn129:47.5: evameva kho bhikkhave ayaṃ rājā cakkavatti sattahi ratanehi samannāgato catūhi ca iddhīhi tatonidānaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti. taṃ dibbassa sukhassa upanidhāya saṅkhampi na upeti kalabhāgampi na upeti upanidhampi na upeti.
mn129:48.1: sa kho so bhikkhave paṇḍito sace kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena manussattaṃ āgacchati yāni tāni uccākulāni
mn129:48.2: khattiyamahāsālakulaṃ vā brāhmaṇamahāsālakulaṃ vā gahapatimahāsālakulaṃ vā tathārūpe kule pacchā jāyati addhe mahaddhane mahābhoge pahūtajātarūparajate pahūtavittūpakaraṇe pahūtadhanadhaññe.
mn129:48.3: so ca hoti abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato lābhī annassa pānassa vatthassa yānassa mālāgandhavilepanassa seyyāvasathapadīpeyyassa.
mn129:48.4: so kāyena sucaritaṃ carati vācāya sucaritaṃ carati manasā sucaritaṃ carati.
mn129:48.5: so kāyena sucaritaṃ caritvā vācāya sucaritaṃ caritvā manasā sucaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
mn129:49.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave akkhadhutto paṭhameneva kaṭaggahena mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ adhigaccheyya.
mn129:49.2: appamattako so bhikkhave kaṭaggaho yaṃ kho so akkhadhutto paṭhameneva kaṭaggahena mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ adhigaccheyya.
mn129:49.3: atha kho ayameva tato mahantataro kaṭaggaho yaṃ so paṇḍito kāyena sucaritaṃ caritvā vācāya sucaritaṃ caritvā manasā sucaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
mn129:49.6: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
